title: Dynamic disulfide bond networks enable self-healable and mechanically resilient intrinsically stretchable organic solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6597-6607
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01082A, Paper
Wenyu Yang, Xuanang Luo, Jiankang Liu, Jingchuan Chen, Xuefei Wu, Zachary Fink, Chuqi Shi, Wenkai Zhong, Cheng Wang, Lei Ying
A dynamic disulfide network introduced into donor/acceptor blends enables room-temperature self-healing and mechanical resilience in intrinsically stretchable organic solar cells, achieving performance recovery after high mechanical strain.
